mapper.select: SELECT id, term_name as termName, synonyms, category, status, description FROM symptom_term ORDER BY category, term_name
SELECT id, term_name as termName, synonyms, category, status, description FROM symptom_term WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO symptom_term (term_name, synonyms, category, status, description) VALUES (#{termName}, #{synonyms}, #{category}, #{status}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE symptom_term SET term_name = #{termName}, synonyms = #{synonyms}, category = #{category}, status = #{status}, description = #{description} WHERE id = #{id}
